description: This file defines a function to build a custom ThemeData object for Flutter applications. It specifies a color palette based on the 'Ocean Professional' theme using specific color codes, and configures various UI component styles like AppBar, ElevatedButton, TextButton, Card, and InputDecoration.

methods.name: buildAdminTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a customized ThemeData object for Flutter app's admin panel, applying the 'Ocean Professional' palette.
